messages:
Maya K.: Quick sync — need to finalize launch gates for Optimize toolkit v1 (batching/caching recommendations + evals). Customer asks from ACME and Nova are high signal. PTAL doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/optimize-v1
Samir B.: Thanks — can we lock scope? Propose 3 gates: 1) eval harness run on 5 canonical prompt sets with pass threshold (quality retention >=95%) 2) perf: >=10% measured token-cost reduction vs baseline 3) infra: canary + auto-fallback verified on 2 models
Jun Park: Perf looks doable but we need concrete KV cache targets. Recommend per-model prefix hit >=30% on representative traces, otherwise caching won't move the needle
Li Chen: For evals, define a regression as >2% drop in automated metric OR >0.04 drop in human evals. Add adversarial and prompt-injection suites to catch corner cases
Emily R.: ACME flagged deterministic suggestions as blocker if cache changes output ordering. They want caching opt-in per-workspace and rollout visibility for each tenant
Liam O.: We'll need token-level tracing hooks + per-route cost export. ETA to ship hooks ~2 sprints if prioritized; otherwise 3
Maya K.: Action items: product to finalise doc + acceptance criteria, eng to sketch perf/kv test plan, ML to assemble prompt sets (incl. adversarial), CS to formalise ACME acceptance criteria. Weekly sync Fridays 11am
Samir B.: :thumbsup: I'll update the doc. Quick q: what's our minimal acceptable cost saving? earlier doc said 10%
Jun Park: We can realistically aim for 15% on long-sequence workloads; 10% is safe for MVL (minimum viable launch)
Li Chen: Draft eval config below — please critique:
```
eval_config:
  prompt_sets: [customer_core, dev_exploits, regen_suite]
  metrics: [quality_delta, token_cost, latency_p95]
  pass_thresholds:
    quality_delta: -0.02
    token_cost: -0.10
    latency_p95: +0.10
  gating_rules:
    - name: acme_keyset_quality
      type: threshold
      dataset: customer_core_acme
      metric: quality_delta
      threshold: -0.015
```
Emily R.: I'll confirm ACME criteria by EOD Friday and flag any must-haves
Maya K.: Also add rollback rule: any regression >1.5% on ACME_keyset -> automatic rollback + page oncall
deploy-bot: canary deployed to 5% traffic for perf smoke
Samir B.: Ok team — once doc updated I want a short table: gate, owner, test, ETA. Keep it tight for exec review
Maya K.: Noted. Will circulate updated doc + checklist before Friday's sync. Thanks everyone!
